landing.heroTitle: One shared truck. Everyone pays less.
landing.heroSub: Gbawia is a digital platform that allows you to save on freight costs by paying only for the space your goods actually occupy. Customers drop off their packages at a shared warehouse, and shipments depart fully loaded with costs shared among users — enabling small shipments to travel just like those of large companies.
landing.processIntro: A truck leaves only when it's economically full — never before, and always within the guaranteed time.

steps.title: Drop off
steps.body: Bring your goods to the nearest Gbawia depot, or we collect them from your door.

steps.title: We share the space
steps.body: Every shipment shares a box with others heading the same way — the space is never half empty.

steps.title: Fill until it pays
steps.body: A truck departs when it's full enough to be convenient. Never before — and never later than promised.

steps.title: It moves
steps.body: Depot to depot, on a scheduled network. Like a bus, but for goods.

steps.title: Collect
steps.body: Pick it up from the depot, or have it delivered to your door.

landing.casesTitle: Made for the people who move things

cases.title: Send a single box
cases.body: Selling a bike, sending a gift, returning an item. One box rides in shared space, without paying for a whole van.

cases.title: Moving home
cases.body: A sofa, a few boxes, a whole flat. We collect it, hold it in the depot, and deliver it to your new address on your date.

cases.title: Ship like a factory
cases.body: From work equipment to small business pallets and bulky products.

about.title: Built like a bus network, for goods
about.lead: Gbawia runs shared warehouses and shared trucks across Italy. Small and medium businesses — and anyone sending a box — pay only for the space their goods occupy, and the truck never leaves half empty.

points.title: You pay for space, not air
points.body: Storage and transport are priced on what your goods actually occupy.

points.title: Full before it leaves
points.body: A truck departs only when it is economically full, always within the maximum guaranteed time. Fewer trips, lower cost, less wasted road.

points.title: Door to door, if you want it
points.body: Drop goods at the depot yourself, or add pickup and delivery to your address. The first and last mile stay with us.

pianifica.title: Plan your route
pianifica.intro: Tell us what you're sending and where it's going. We'll work out the price and the guaranteed date.

monitora.title: Your shipment
monitora.emptyBody: Plan a route and track where your packet is here.

monitor.title: Live network
monitor.intro: The network executes a movement plan: vehicles leave warehouses, drop off and pick up goods, and products wait at intermediate nodes before continuing on another vehicle.
monitor.warehousesEmpty: No goods in the warehouses for now.
monitor.warehouseEmpty: The warehouse is empty for now.
monitor.legendFull: At the threshold — ready to leave
monitor.futureNotice: Intermodal: Cagliari and Palermo join by ship.

docs.title: Help center
docs.intro: Ask anything about how Gbawia works — pricing, the network, or how the truck decides when to leave.
docs.fallbackAsk: I can answer questions about Gbawia. Ask me about pricing, the shared network, or delivery dates.
docs.noKey: Live answers need an API key. Meanwhile: Gbawia fills every truck to capacity before it leaves, and you pay only for the space your goods occupy. Try asking about pricing or guaranteed dates, or plan a route to see a real price.
docs.sourceNote: Answers are grounded in our operating guide.

footer.blurb: Shared freight network. Pay for the space your goods occupy, never for the air around them.
footer.author: Giulia Esposito
